name: Alajeró (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and green with a double-width yellow stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Alajeró (a dragon tree on yellow above a sea).
history: The flag of the municipality was approved by the same council session of November 2002 that approved the arms, as a rectangular cloth of proportion 2:3 divided vertically into three stripes, the central one yellow and twice the width of the outer blue and green ones.

features.role: Alajeró arms — dragon tree above the sea on yellow
